title: Startup and host integration
invariant: Follow the host boundary: workspace identity scopes the mounted runtime; native panel navigation and DOM stay inside its host. Native panel sizing must fill the viewport remainder in HA’s auto-height wrapper while preserving sidebar flow and safe-area padding.

title: Project schema and persistence
invariant: Trace draft, published state and revision checks before changing persistence; preserve portable IDs and migrations. Personal GLBs are immutable SHA assets outside snapshots; references and record publication share a transaction. Unsupported fields and newer schema versions stay blocked and explain the HACS update, restart and reload recovery path. Weather source preferences are private and origin-scoped; their revision-checked save updates only that field in draft and published profiles.

title: Editor coordination
invariant: Keep mode coordination separate from domain edits, history, persistence and presentation; Apply is the publication boundary.

title: Construct and floor topology
invariant: Start at topology and validation for architectural changes: walls own openings; junctions and derived collision must agree. Optional door/window finish colors follow opening history and persistence without changing geometry. North orientation previews around the plan; only confirmation commits the shared building angle. Boundary (H) reuses hedge drawing, selection and persisted IDs. Wall edge color uses Auto or a persisted custom CSS color; Auto inherits matching authored side colors, then authored exterior color, otherwise the general interior wall finish. Face color controls follow wall direction and adjacent-room labels, preserve the opposite side, reset to the home palette, and highlight the edited face without persisting UI state.

title: Arrange and placement
invariant: Resolve catalog definitions and supported placement before changing item records; preserve floor and item identity through history. Optional fabric colors follow item history and persistence; model defaultColor enables the picker. 3D elevation dragging preserves support and horizontal placement, commits one history step on release, and restores the initial placement on cancellation. Proportional resize dragging preserves placement, respects model resize policies, and shares the single-transaction commit/cancel behavior.

title: Connect and binding profiles
invariant: Keep local slot declarations separate from browser household mappings; matching and rescan remain read-only.

title: Personal GLB models and asset transfer
invariant: Distribute the standalone authoring skill from the public cabane-app/agent-skills repository. Keep personal import and illustrated AI-generation guidance inside Arrange's My models section. Manage models directly in its single preview grid, with hover, keyboard and touch access. Resolve personal definitions per project; validate self-contained GLBs and resource budgets before storage. Preserve materials, share and dispose resources, and publish verified assets before documents. Keep private bindings and authenticated transfers isolated by HA origin; interrupted transfers preserve the prior revision.

title: Home Assistant runtime and controls
invariant: Resolve and authorize supported controls at runtime; credentials and household IDs stay outside generated home source. Storage transfers remain bound to their originating authenticated session. Demo devices stay in memory, and simulated lights start on when the demo opens in night lighting while remaining manually controllable. Demo fans start at 50% speed and valves start open; normal controls update their in-memory state and existing catalog animations respect reduced motion.

title: Dashboard, navigation and cameras
invariant: Room selection glides to a consistent angle fitted beside controls; manual navigation interrupts and retains active pointer listeners across dashboard re-renders, reduced motion settles immediately, and overview restores the default floor framing. The combined floor summary expands floor pills that update the active floor and room list; mobile keeps the floor pill and hides room pills. Keep floor switching and walk state coherent; missing runtime data must leave a usable scene. Room and device modules use content-sized cards and wrapping titles, with compact controls that preserve usable action targets. Overlay preferences persist locally and filter only overview summaries. Area temperature/humidity readings take precedence over usable mapped room sensor fallbacks. RoomControlSheet and useRoomModuleOrder own browser-local per-home/room module order; RoomModuleReorder provides pointer, touch, and keyboard reordering without HA commands. Weather shares the Build/View tray and SceneActionButton rendering, uses matching sculpted icons and six preview choices (Live, Sunny, Cloudy, Rain, Thunderstorm, Snowy), defaults to Sunny with Live disabled when no HA weather entity exists, and applies only a visit-local scene override; it never changes HA state or the saved weather source.

title: Scene geometry and rendering
invariant: Trace derived geometry and collision from floor architecture; authored geometry uses toon rendering; hosted visual assets follow the asset contract, and personal GLBs retain their dedicated validated import owner. Active-floor emitters retain zero-intensity lights across state changes to avoid shader recompilation. Room emphasis updates floor materials and wall vertex colors without rebuilding geometry or changing device lights. Solar direction follows geographic north; one resolved source drives Auto lighting and its label, with building-sized solar shadows and unshadowed luminaires. Interior right-angle endpoint corners share a filled footprint across batched and standalone geometry. Architectural planes retain exact geometry during LOD selection. Orbit wall cutaways retain cast shadows during opacity transitions. Boundary styles retain the hedges wire format and continuous segment collision, including open fences. Floor preset colors are portable optional hex values; procedural tile patterns retain neutral grout. Standalone and batched wall caps and opening reveals share edge-finish precedence; shared horizontal junction surfaces retain the general finish when owners disagree. Horizontal caps are partitioned by finish before triangulation to prevent color bleeding across adjacent walls. DEFAULT_WALL_COLORS is the single source of production wall palette defaults; authored finishes take precedence. Interior Auto edges ignore stale exterior paint metadata. Dark walnut and both light-oak directions use deterministic fine grain and staggered boards in an engine-owned repeating canvas texture. The shared toon gradient retains four flat bands with narrow filtered boundaries so orbital camera motion cannot flip whole-wall brightness at a light threshold. Weather modifies appearance after solar resolution; the explicit daylight factor remains solar-owned. Drei Clouds uses a pinned hosted texture with isolated loading and no depth writes. A single far-depth weather backdrop adds layered clouds and distant rain behind architecture, follows solar daylight, and freezes under reduced motion. Procedural precipitation uses visibility-independent roof shelter, and weather frames stop when clear, reduced-motion or hidden.

title: Catalog and model extensions
invariant: Inspect stable registries first; supported catalog subpaths are the consumer boundary and home extensions own bespoke geometry. Single-window curtains reuse independent window-fit placement and variant metadata. Framed hinged leaves fit their jamb aperture and retain rear-corner sweep clearance. Flush and concealed styles expose explicit finish-plane controls. Roll-up slats own smooth, reversible position tracking with retained geometry and immediate reduced-motion poses. Catalog activity follows resolved state; decorative holograms preserve depth occlusion and physical bounds, and reduced motion retains a static active cue. TV comic artwork uses ordered depth bias with depth testing retained; active wall TVs omit glass reflections and reduced motion freezes the flight. Rattan bell pendants are light devices; their retired furnishing entry remains hidden for saved-project compatibility.

title: Optional walk tools
invariant: Register optional tools in the web host; injected navigation, activation and storage keep HA access inside the engine. Prepare and retain shot shader programs on equip to avoid trigger-time compilation. The gun owns its first-use tutorial and browser-local dismissal. Engine targeting toggles one available light, fan, climate, media-player, switch or valve binding, preserving explicit slot scope and rejecting ambiguous targets.

title: Bundled home and agent generation
invariant: Author one accepted layout or room stage at a time in home/; browser edits do not rewrite the bundled seed. Follow the generation skill review gates.

title: Verification and delivery
invariant: Use verify:help to select iteration checks; unknown or shared impact requires the complete verify gate, as does shared product delivery. Dependency changes require a complete portable lockfile and clean npm ci with the host npm version. Fixture/build success does not establish household, deployment or cross-browser acceptance. Full tests run locally before delivery; Actions validates contracts, builds, packages and publishes without rerunning tests. A changed persisted contract requires a new fingerprint, revision and compatibility notes; a main push publishes the locally verified matching integration through the scoped release workflow.

title: Shortcuts and private HA actions
invariant: Keep shortcut order and kinds portable; scene/script entity IDs belong to origin-scoped draft/published binding profiles. Save publishes both atomically. Activation uses guarded one-shot commands, never toggles.
